name: lanes
description: A **text-based DAW**. Your song is a folder of CUE files; the terminal (or a web editor) is your studio.

scripts.engine:buildstart: npm run engine:dev && npm run engine:start
scripts.lanes:build:win: cd engine && cmake --preset windows-msvc && cmake --build --preset windows-msvc
scripts.lanes:build:mac: cd engine && cmake --preset macos-clang && cmake --build --preset macos-clang
scripts.lanes:test:mac: cd engine && cmake --preset macos-clang && cmake --build build/macos-clang --target lanes_engine_tests && ctest --test-dir build/macos-clang -R lanes_engine_tests --output-on-failure
